name: RfcUntouchedManualDraftHardDelete
purpose: Permit hard deletion only for the exceptionally narrow untouched local RFC draft allowed by authority; otherwise preserve identity/history through lifecycle/archive/correction.

all_must_be_true: RFC was created manually or as a purely local provisional draft and has no accepted RFC/WFM source adoption/provenance
RFC has no active or historical RFC hierarchy edge as parent or child
RFC has no active or historical SR relationship
RFC has no active or historical Device Reference relationship
RFC has no Working Notes or removed/edited note audit history
RFC owns no WFM identity and no WFM/Task history
RFC participates in no Task/Objective/execution/review history
RFC has no Communication link/history whose retention depends on it
RFC has no accepted lifecycle/status/source evidence beyond its local creation
audit/history classification contains only the permitted local creation evidence and no later protected action
all cross-domain dependency providers return CLEAR; INDETERMINATE fails closed

preview.output: eligible boolean, exact RFC revision, typed blockers, determinate/indeterminate provider results, provider freshness tokens and canonical SHA-256 eligibility_fingerprint
preview.fingerprint: hash contract version + RFC immutable/business identity + RFC revision + sorted local guard results + named provider results/freshness tokens
preview.rule: preview is advisory and cannot authorize deletion; explicit confirmation is bound to the fingerprint

steps: rerun every local eligibility guard and cross-domain provider check against current state using indexed existence checks
recompute eligibility_fingerprint and require it matches the reviewed eligible preview
if revision/fingerprint changed return RFC_HARD_DELETE_PREVIEW_STALE; if any blocker/INDETERMINATE exists return RFC_HARD_DELETE_BLOCKED; make no mutation
append the minimal hard-delete audit event while rfc_id/rfc_no are still available; the current deletion command's own receipt/audit are excluded from the pre-command untouched-history predicate
delete only the RFC row; no generic cascade is used and any unexpected FK dependency aborts/rolls back

audit_resolution: LLD-01 audit_events.target_id is evidence text rather than an RFC foreign key, so the required deletion audit survives the RFC row. The permitted creation audit and current deletion audit are distinguished from intervening protected history; no audit exception weakens dependency eligibility.
rules: no dependent deletion, unlink or cascade is used to manufacture eligibility
a manual RFC with any independently protected WFM/Task/Objective/Communication/Inventory history is not hard-deletable
ordinary imported/adopted/history-bearing RFCs use archive/terminal/correction flows instead
hard deletion never applies merely because RFC is archived, terminal, old, omitted from workbook, or currently has no active WFM
repositories expose no generic RFC delete method outside this service
